description: Extract dominant colors from any image.

faqs.a: The image is drawn at about 64px, its pixels are bucketed into 4-bit-per-channel color bins, and the 8 bins with the most pixels win. The displayed hex is the average color of each winning bin.
It is a fast approximation, not a perceptual clustering algorithm — near-identical shades can merge, and tiny but vivid accents may be missed.
Click any swatch to copy its HEX value to the clipboard.
faqs.q: How do I copy a color?

howto: The 8 dominant colors are extracted automatically.
Click any swatch to copy its HEX value.
All processing happens locally — nothing is uploaded.
title: Image Palette Extractor
